summary: Combat Daggers with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
keyTalents: Hack and Slash 5/5 (mace off hand: armor ignored)
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when it's down. Refresh it at 5 with under 1s left
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Eureka! (Gnome) on cooldown while Slice and Dice has 8s+ left
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less. Sapper and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points when Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ energy, or with under 6s left. Spend leftover points in the last 3s
A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) beside a Dense Sharpening Stone and Instant Poison (off hand) beside a Dense Weightstone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Backstab and Eviscerate stop at rank VIII and Deadly Poison at IV. The books would add 13 to 18 DPS.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add about 8 and 6 DPS.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. The flask gives its full bonus only there.
Uses Flask of Natural Accuracy over Natural Precision. Its 5% hit still helps white hits (+0.1 to +0.6 DPS).
9% hit (10 hit rating on the wrist). It beats 8% by 1.1 to 1.8 DPS. 10% is between 0.6 behind and 0.1 ahead.
No Goblin Land Mine. Its 1s cast resets the swing, so it loses DPS. The Sapper stays.
